summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a sale of a Dollar Tree-occupied net lease retail property in Morrow, Georgia. The sale was made by its indirect wholly owned subsidiary GIPGA 2383 Lake Harbin Road, LLC to Vanguard Asset Holdings, LLC, Series 102, for a purchase price of $1,458,000, with net proceeds of approximately $639,152 after prorations and adjustments. The transaction closed on April 17, 2026, pursuant to a Purchase and Sale Agreement effective March 23, 2026, as amended April 2, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. The filing notes that pro forma financials will be provided by amendment. What to watch: any subsequent use of proceeds for debt reduction, acquisitions, or shareholder returns.
